title: One program dashboard: add the decision network to the PMO dashboard and refresh its snapshot
story: As the sponsor I want a single program dashboard that includes the decision network so that I do not have to watch two pages
acceptance: Sponsor decision (2026-10-19): the PMO dashboard (dashboard/, published as 'FNOL Program Dashboard') is the one dashboard; the decision network moves into it from the live board (dashboard/live.html, 'Decision network' tab, canvas renderer around lines 270-410 reading graph.json)

dashboard/app.js gets a 'Decision network' tab that renders the same graph (agents, teams and hubs as nodes; messages, reviews, assignments and agent runs as edges; filters and a legend as on the live board), keyboard-accessible tab, readable in light and dark, works at 390 px width

build() in dashboard/server.mjs includes the graph computed by the same code as org/live-export.mjs (import its build, do not duplicate the logic) so both the live server (/api/snapshot) and the exported snapshot carry it; real records only, nothing invented

Snapshot robustness: node dashboard/export.mjs writes dashboard/snapshot.html that renders every tab without network access and without errors (Playwright test opens the file, clicks every tab, asserts no console errors and no 'Try again'/error state), and the file stays under 2 MB
Screenshots docs/design/screens/dashboard-overview.png and dashboard-network.png at 1440x900; node --test tests/unit/dashboard/*.test.mjs passes; full npm test no new failures
brief: Read dashboard/live.html (the network renderer and its data shape from org/live-export.mjs build().graph) and dashboard/app.js (TABS, views, render). Keep zero dependencies. Do not edit org/live-export.mjs (export a function from it only if needed by posting to the pmo hub; prefer importing build and the helpers it already exports). The orchestrator republishes snapshot.html to the sponsor's dashboard artifact after acceptance.
